# Apply report — #104 portable npm identity and license posture

**Status:** unfinished (AC2–AC5 delivered; AC1 auth-blocked)  
**Branch:** `fix/issue-104-npm-identity`  
**Baseline commit:** `625110dca92cabeb18aa4e65eb2f47027d982237`  
**Authority:** plan-court converged r1+r2+r3 (2026-08-05)

## AC checklist

| AC | Result | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- |
| AC1 Registry identity | **unfinished** | `npm whoami` → `ENEEDAUTH` (need auth / `npm adduser`). Unauthenticated `npm view @ak/pi-workflow-roles` → 404 (name free on public registry, **not** proof of publish rights). Name left `@ak/pi-workflow-roles`. Fallback order documented in `docs/npm-identity.md`. No rename on vibes. |
| AC2 Apache-2.0 project license | **done** | Root `LICENSE` = complete unmodified Apache-2.0 text (no copyright appendix per r2). `package.json` `"license": "Apache-2.0"`. `files` includes `LICENSE`. Packed content equality asserted. |
| AC3 Separate Matt MIT notice | **done** | `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`: project Apache-2.0 separation header; full upstream MIT including `Copyright (c) 2026 Matt Pocock`, permission grant, warranty disclaimer; `mattpocock/skills` + four skill names. Not project license; not dual-license. No skill bodies. |
| AC4 Explicit peer ranges + matrix | **done** | Peers: pi-ai/coding-agent `~0.83.0`; typebox `>=1.3.7 <=1.3.8`. devDeps pinned `0.83.0` / `0.83.0` / `1.3.8`. Both matrix cells green (below). |
| AC5 Packed metadata via npm pack seam | **done** | `test/package/npm-identity-metadata.test.ts` uses `getSharedIsolatedPack()` (real `npm pack`); extracts tarball; no `npm i -g` / second global copy. |

## TDD evidence

**Seam:** packed artifact via `getSharedIsolatedPack()` / real `npm pack` (existing package harness).

**Red (before implementation):**
```
node --import tsx --test test/package/npm-identity-metadata.test.ts
# 3 fail — ENOENT package/LICENSE (and missing license/peer/notice posture)
```

**Green (after implementation + git add so materialize sees new paths):**
```
# tests 3 / pass 3 / fail 0
```

Assertions (content, not path-only):
1. Packed `package.json.license === "Apache-2.0"` and extracted `LICENSE` **equals** canonical Apache-2.0 fixture (`test/fixtures/licenses/Apache-2.0.txt` from apache.org).
2. Packed `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md` embeds complete Matt MIT fixture text; license field not MIT/dual; notice ≠ LICENSE; names four skills + `mattpocock/skills`.
3. Packed peers are strings, none `*`, equal evidence-bounded literals; match source `package.json`.

## Compatibility matrix (r2)

| Cell | Installed | typecheck | test:fast |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Pi 0.83.0 + pi-ai 0.83.0 + typebox **1.3.7** | confirmed via `node_modules/*/package.json` | pass | 271 pass / 0 fail |
| Pi 0.83.0 + pi-ai 0.83.0 + typebox **1.3.8** | confirmed | pass | 271 pass / 0 fail |

## Repo gates (locked dev install, typebox 1.3.8)

- `npm run typecheck` — pass  
- `npm run test:fast` — 271 pass  
- `npm run test:all` — **348 pass / 0 fail** (duration ~92s)

## Same-pattern check

- Reused `getSharedIsolatedPack` / pack file-list path style from existing `test/package/*` lifecycle tests; added extract-and-assert content checks required by r2.
- License/notice shipped as root pack files via explicit `files` entries (same contract surface as README/packets).
- Maintainer note is docs-only (`docs/npm-identity.md`); no Soul/runtime/CLI surface changes.
- No parallel pack mechanism; no skill body packing (#109+).

## Introduced-regression check

- Full `test:all` green on baseline commit tree after changes.
- Scope limited to package metadata, license/notice artifacts, peer pins, pack tests, maintainer doc.
- Cold-install still keys `@ak/pi-workflow-roles` (name unchanged) — consistent with AC1 unfinished hold.
- ADR 0009 not rewritten (product path owned by ADR 0052 / #11; out of ticket).

## Behavior-fact check

| Claim | Fact |
| --- | --- |
| Project SPDX | `"license": "Apache-2.0"` in `package.json` |
| LICENSE bytes | complete Apache-2.0; no copyright holder/year appendix (r2/r3) |
| Matt notice | separate file; full MIT text; not `package.json.license` |
| Peers | no `*`; ranges match matrix-executed versions only |
| Pack proof | real npm pack tarball paths + extracted fields/files |
| Publishability of `@ak/…` | **not established** — ENEEDAUTH |

## AC1 blocker (do not wash)

```
npm whoami
# npm error code ENEEDAUTH
# npm error need auth This command requires you to be logged in.
```

Unauthenticated public 404 on the name is insufficient for publish-rights claims. Per court constraint: **do not close #104** until authenticated identity is settled.

## Files in baseline `625110d`

- `LICENSE`, `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`
- `package.json`, `package-lock.json` (license + peer/dev pin metadata only at root)
- `docs/npm-identity.md`
- `test/fixtures/licenses/Apache-2.0.txt`, `test/fixtures/licenses/matt-pocock-skills-MIT.txt`
- `test/package/npm-identity-metadata.test.ts`

## Out of scope (honored)

No npm publish; no skill runtime bodies; no `ak-role` CLI; no product README invocation rewrite; no ADR rewrite; no copyright presumption.
